# Aunt Jamesina & Phil Gordon

- [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) — Friend of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — loves and lives with her · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place and decorate their new home. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopts a stray, disreputable cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who miraculously survives a chloroforming attempt and earns a permanent spot in the house. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives with her own cats, adding to the household's lively atmosphere.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) shares her relaxed views on chaperone duties and introduces her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat, to Patty's Place. [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) tries to fight both newcomers, getting put in his place by the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat and engaging in repeated battles with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) before becoming his close friend. The girls and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) chat comfortably together about their household routine and pet antics.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) chat about the snowy weather and rising prices. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then reads aloud a humorous letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), who reports on local news from home including Mrs. Lynde's misadventures, his school essay, and various neighborhood gossip.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) discuss [Anne](../character/anne.md) turning twenty and her character growth. [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) joins them, showing off her dress before leaving for a dance while they chat about her suitors, including [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) departs, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) fondly ponder Phil's whimsical personality.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

> In a letter to [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describes her summer at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), including the quirky guests at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse. She recounts meeting [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/blake.md), a theological student who initially seemed funny and ugly to her. After hearing him deliver a moving sermon, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) realizes her deep admiration for him and nervously contemplates whether she is falling in love.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place before deciding to take a walk in the park. Catch in a sudden rainstorm, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets a handsome fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student named Royal Gardner, who rescues her with his umbrella and walks her home. Later that evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her housemates.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> While getting dressed for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) compliments [Anne](../character/anne.md) on her dress and mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels inexplicably bothered by the news and travels to the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). Upon arriving, [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room talking to the beautiful Christine and quietly compares her own appearance to hers.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

> At Patty's Place, the girls prepare for exams and learn that they can rent the house for another year while the owners travel abroad. Later, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future and Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) ponders her ideal romance alongside Roy's lack of humor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

> The girls return to Patty's Place and chatter with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about their vacations, Phil's engagement, and Aunt Jamesina's past suitors. Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cure a rainy-day bout of melancholy by reading over old, melodramatic stories written by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club), inspiring [Anne](../character/anne.md) to rewrite one of her old sketches.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives news that her short sketch has been accepted by a publication, sparking literary excitement among the girls at Patty's Place. While on a walking party, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne.md) that his mother and sisters plan to call on her. The Gardners arrive a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to an awkward but ultimately successful first visit despite cat chaos and a ruined chocolate cake.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their examinations finish up. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne.md) chooses Gilbert's lilies over Roy's violets to carry, but later learns of a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), leading her to secretly break the chain [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave her. After attending the graduation dance, the girls unwind back at Patty's Place while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) mentions a visitor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

> At Patty's Place, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on their time together and pack up as their college life ends. [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) to the harbor pavilion and proposes, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his offer. Deeply upset, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who scolds her before ultimately offering comfort.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn
